principles: append evidence; do not rewrite history
never retain credentials or private Main Brain content
separate integrity evidence from identity claims

preview_receipt.reason: decision trace without indefinite low-value retention

deletion_rule: Retention expiry permits removal only under an explicit retention process; deletion must not rewrite surviving receipt-chain claims as if removed evidence never existed.
note: Repository history and hashes provide useful evidence but are not by themselves a legal archive, digital signature, or proof of human identity.
